text:
Priya: quick thread  i'm updating the Hello Quickstart to cover the v8 SDK rename + the new minimal deploy flags. draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4522
Diego: nice. what's the compatibility story we should call out?
Priya: main points: 1) rename auth.ephemeralToken() -> auth.getEphemeralToken() in v8, 2) CLI now needs --region or PROJECT_REGION env var or deploy errors silently, 3) recommend ephemeral tokens for browser demos only.
Hannah: please add a small "Migration note" box right after the first code sample that shows the old vs new call. readers appreciate a one-line swap.
Priya: planned snippet box:
```js
// v7
// const token = await client.auth.ephemeralToken({ ttl: 60 })
// v8+
const token = await client.auth.getEphemeralToken({ ttl: 60 }) // ttl in seconds
```
Diego: sgtm. also add which package version the example pins to (e.g. "@redwood/sdk@^8.1.0"). prevents surprises.
Hannah: add a one-line prod caveat: "Do not use ephemeral tokens for servers or production long-lived workflows; use KMS-backed JWTs or service tokens." link to /guides/security.
ci-bot: link-checker: found broken link -> /guides/security-old (404)
Priya: thanks, updated to /guides/security and pushed.
Diego: the sample app in the repo still imports REDWOOD_API_KEY in the .env.example. change to REDWOOD_TOKEN and call out PROJECT_REGION in the README.
Priya: will update .env.example and regenerate the screenshot.
Hannah: add a tiny preflight checklist at the top: REDWOOD_TOKEN, PROJECT_REGION, smallest role needed. two bullets max.
Priya: added.
Diego: lint flagged unused `formatTimestamp` helper in the sample. either remove or export it in the demo. simpler to drop.
Priya: removed the helper and pushed.
ci-bot: docs-build passed; link-checker re-run -> 0 broken links.
guide-bot: image-checker noticed the screenshot in /assets/quickstart still shows OLD_LABEL: REDWOOD_API_KEY
Priya: re-exporting screenshot with updated env label now.
Hannah: can we also add a tiny troubleshooting line: "If deploy fails with 403, check PROJECT_REGION and the demo role."
Priya: added a two-line troubleshooting section with 401/403 quick checks + clock-skew note.
Diego: one more ask: include a tiny curl example for non-JS readers showing Authorization header usage. keeps it language-neutral.
Priya: added a 1-line curl example.
Hannah: LGTM once the screenshot and package.json pin make it into the branch.
Priya: pushing final assets now, will ping when CI is green :rocket:
Priya: CI green. thanks everyone! :tada:
